ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominance of low-intensity pixels (approximately 85% of visible surface) with localized high-intensity (white) pixels (approximately 15%) primarily concentrated at the posterior boundary and lateral tips.

Distinct high-intensity pixel clusters are located at the extreme lateral tips. Sparse, low-density light-colored circular pixel clusters are distributed across the dark background of the central-left lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous jagged boundary along the trailing edge with irregular pixel-amplitude peaks and valleys; higher serration frequency observed towards the lateral tips compared to the median notch.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve trajectory observed on the posterior edges of both lobes, tapering to acute points at the lateral extremities.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Discrete circular high-contrast white pixel clusters are detected along the trailing edge of the right lobe and scattered across the surface of the left lobe.
